method: Provider start/finish times, or recorded terminal observation upper bounds for canceled children, rounded upward to job minutes. Phase costs include root and child hardware plus exposed-port charges. Recipe total includes the two training segments and both merge exports; earlier development and CPU checks are reported separately.
training_note: Two segments including a diagnostic process crash and continuation from checkpoint10; one discarded step and both startups are included.
merge_note: Includes original mounted export and one CPU-only check of corrected direct SDK export. The model weights are content-identical.
